name: alert
title: Alert
description: An animated alert for React and shadcn, for context, success, warning and error messages.

meta.details: An inline callout for context, success, warnings and errors. It springs open and closed on its own height, and when the tone changes the tint cross-fades and the icon swaps.

docs: Import Alert from components/eased/alert/alert. Props: tone (neutral, info, success, warning, danger), title, children, icon, actions, onDismiss, open, role, innerClassName. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.
